newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO STARTS AUCTIONS FOR 43 MINE PROPERTIES.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO STARTS AUCTIONS FOR 43 MINE PROPERTIES.

text.p: Mexico's Trade Minister Herminio Blanco announced Wednesday the start of the process to auction off 43 mine properties around the country.
Blanco said the properties would be sold off in lots. The first one has six properties, with auction details going on sale at the ministry from August 12.
The six properties, which have been semi-explored, are:
--Carabina in Sonora state (gold, silver zinc and lead)
--Triunfo Uno in BCS state (gold, silver, zinc and lead)
--Ampliacion El Triunfo in Durango state (gold and copper)
--Cerro Prieto-El Orito in Durango state (gold and copper)
--San Pablo in Durango state (gold and copper)
"They are not the biggest properties, we decided to start with a package of some of the medium and small-sized properties and others will follow in coming weeks," Blanco said.
Under Mexican mining laws, foreign and national companies are allowed to take part in the auction.
Companies winning the rights to the properties are expected to complete full exploration studies with a view to moving into exploitation phases in the future.
